name: VWAP band fade (5m, ±b SD) back toward VWAP — mean-reverting tape only (acr 1–5 min)
why: Execution algos benchmark to VWAP; far from it they slow down or reverse their child orders, so stretched prices mean-revert toward VWAP. Tape filter pre-registered 2026-10-17 (research/preregistered/2026-10-17_tape_filter_all.md).
